messages:
Aisha (sec): Heads-up: external pen test with Vector Labs next Mon 04/11. Need plan for RBAC, KMS access, audit index, and retest SLA. Assessor: infra@vectorlabs.io.
Ben (eng-sre): Agreed ephemeral roles only. Provide explicit assume-role docs and session duration of 2h.
Lena (infra): I'll create role vector-pt-assessor-ephem with least-priv S3 read, CloudWatch Logs read, and no permanent KMS Decrypt.
Tom (platform): KMS approach proposal: prefer CreateGrant + short TTL and revoke after transfer. Alternative is a decrypt-proxy service but that increases attack surface.
Aisha (sec): Good. Example grant flow for ops: `aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-vector --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/vector-pt-assessor-ephem --operations Decrypt GenerateDataKey --name vector-pt-grant` Capture grantId for audit.
Lena (infra): Runbook: create grant -> create encrypted bundle -> presign URLs -> transfer -> revoke grant -> post SHA256 in GH issue.
Ben (eng-sre): I'll create Splunk index `pt-vector` (90d retention) and an S3 prefix s3://redwood-pt/vector/<ticket-id> with bucket policy restricting writes from our presigner only.
Aisha (sec): Remediation workflow: GH repo `pt-remediations`, label `vector-pt`, milestone `VECTOR-2026-04`. Use template with vuln repro, logs attached, PR link, QA steps. Severity: Critical->P0, High->P1, etc. P0 -> pager + war room.
Tom (platform): Evidence checklist: app logs (24h), infra logs, config dump, K/V cache snapshot, KMS grant audit record, bundle SHA256. Ensure scrubber run: `/opt/bin/log-scrub --mask-pii` before upload.
Ben (eng-sre): Retest process: label `ready-for-retest`, ping channel, schedule within 7 business days if possible. I'll add GH automation to add calendar event on label.
sched-bot: Tentative retest slot created: Tue 04/19 10:00-13:00 PST. Invite sent to #eng-security.
Aisha (sec): Actions: Lena to create role + grant playbook; Ben to create index + GH milestone/template; Tom to publish runbook snippet. Quick sync tomorrow 09:30 PST to finalize.
